kebab_example: aliyun vpc disable-vpc-classic-link --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp1m7v25emi1h5mtc0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableVpcClassicLink

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC for which you want to disable ClassicLink.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要关闭ClassicLink功能的VPC所在的地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC for which you want to disable ClassicLink
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
